jp.kyasu.graphics

クラス TextScanner

  • java.lang.Object
    • jp.kyasu.graphics.TextScanner
  • 直系の既知のサブクラス:
    EchoTextScanner, TextListScanner

    public class TextScanner
extends java.lang.Object
    The TextScanner class scans text to lay out text, to draw text, and to compute the position of text.

      • NO_STOPS

        public static final int[] NO_STOPS
        The stop conditions for the first 256 characters. This constant is used for scanning as is.

      • SIMPLE_STOPS

        public static final int[] SIMPLE_STOPS
        The stop conditions for the first 256 characters. This constant is used for ignoring the ANSI control characters.

      • JAVA_STOPS

        public static final int[] JAVA_STOPS
        The stop conditions for the first 256 characters. This constant is used for scanning the text without line break, i.e., scanning '\f', '\n' (Text.LINE_SEPARATOR_CHAR) as LINE_SEPARATOR.
        関連項目:
        Text.LINE_SEPARATOR_CHAR, RichTextStyle.isJavaLineSeparator()

      • JAVA_BREAK_STOPS

        public static final int[] JAVA_BREAK_STOPS
        The stop conditions for the first 256 characters. This constant is used for scanning the text with line break, i.e., scanning '\f', '\n' (Text.LINE_SEPARATOR_CHAR) as LINE_SEPARATOR, and '\r' (Text.LINE_BREAK_CHAR) as LINE_BREAK.
        関連項目:
        Text.LINE_SEPARATOR_CHAR, Text.LINE_BREAK_CHAR, RichTextStyle.isJavaLineSeparatorWithBreak()

      • LIST_STOPS

        public static final int[] LIST_STOPS
        The stop conditions for the first 256 characters. This constant is used for scanning list items.
        関連項目:
        Text.LIST_SEPARATOR_CHAR, RichTextStyle.isListSeparator()

      • fastScanChars

        protected final int fastScanChars(int begin,
                                  int end,
                                  char[] chars,
                                  int rightX,
                                  int[] stops,
                                  int bufferSize)
        Scans the array of characters and returns the stop condition if the scanning runs to the end, the scanning runs across the rightX, or the scanning encounters the stop condition defined in the stops.

        This operation is efficient even if all characters in the array are larger than 256.

        パラメータ:
        begin - the beginning index of scanning. (inclusive)
        end - the ending index of scanning. (exclusive)
        chars - the array of characters to be scanned.
        rightX - the right edge for scanning.
        stops - the stop conditions for scanning.
        bufferSize - the buffer size for calling FontMetrics#charsWidth(char[], int, int)
        戻り値:
        the stop condition.

      • slowScanChars

        protected final int slowScanChars(int begin,
                                  int end,
                                  char[] chars,
                                  int rightX,
                                  int[] stops)
        Scans the array of characters and returns the stop condition if the scanning runs to the end, the scanning runs across the rightX, or the scanning encounters the stop condition defined in the stops.

        This operation is not efficient because it calls FontMetrics#charsWidth(char) at each character.

        パラメータ:
        begin - the beginning index of scanning. (inclusive)
        end - the ending index of scanning. (exclusive)
        chars - the array of characters to be scanned.
        rightX - the right edge for scanning.
        stops - the stop conditions for scanning.
        戻り値:
        the stop condition.
